name: SIDE CRUNCHES LEFT
introduce:
Lie on your right side with your right foot behind your left foot. 

Put your left hand behind your head and your right hand on the left side of your oblique muscles. 

Lift your right shoulder up off the floor. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please contract your obliques during each rep.
Exhale as you raise up, and inhale as you lower down.
This exercise targets your oblique muscles.
